posts.body_html: hi, my question is what is the best substrate for hcw clone f and how to water it? (puddles, breaks etc ...) I just lost one to rot 😞

posts.body_html:
Mar 22, 2021 21:58:46 GMT -5 Jean ram nav said:
hi, my question is what is the best substrate for hcw clone f and how to water it? (puddles, breaks etc ...) I just lost one to rot 😞


Sphagnum Peat. Some add a percentage of perlite or sand. Pure water; RO, distilled or rain water. Moist in winter, wet during growth (spring thru fall)

posts.body_html: One of my favourite albas, it has only one thing that bugs me quite a bit... the lid is kinda short! I don't know if you could get your hands on it Mike, but Sarracenia leucophylla L34/C from Miroslav Srba would be an interesting parent for a cross!

posts.body_html:
Not quite super white fall traps, these are still late summer traps that are less interesting, but still worth documenting. Many out there might think this clone is crazy white all the time, but that's usually only the case when greenhouse grown or if your plant is producing fall pitchers. Pics taken 8/17/22:


out of literally hundreds of divisions of hurricane creek white clone F, these traps are currently the whitest, most aren't all that spectacular, but the fall show is coming soon, so there should be some really amazing stuff to look at in the next 2 weeks or so:




To be continued.....
